name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Merit Scholarship
eligibility: Class 12 pass with 80%+, family income below ₹2.5L
description: Government-funded scholarship for meritorious students pursuing UG studies.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
eligibility: OBC category students, family income below ₹1 lakh
description: Assistance for OBC students in post-matric courses.

name: Tata Means Grant
eligibility: UG/PG students with strong academics and low income
description: Financial assistance to talented but economically weaker students.

name: Adobe Women-in-Tech Scholarship
eligibility: Female students in CS, IT, AI/ML, or related fields
description: Scholarship and internship for outstanding women in technology.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education
eligibility: Top 1% in 12th boards OR JEE/NEET rank holders
description: Government scholarship to promote careers in natural sciences.
